value.rationale: The area of the joint ballistic velocity spectrum measures the planar reachability footprint independently of initial state, whereas the source maximum coordinate speed fixes only its one-dimensional projections. The theorem distinguishes equal-speed models with different propagation geometry, solves fixed-speed coin-balance design exactly, and supplies a sharp global stability coefficient and nonanalytic speed-limit deficit. These exact natural continuum invariants and inequalities are not mere renamings or computations of an already stated area table. Limits: only this homogeneous two-state family; no initial-state weighted density optimization or finite-time transport.
